research_question: How to quantitatively decouple true feature reliance from intervention-induced edge artifacts?
closest_prior_art: Hooker et al. (2019) ROAR; Fong & Vedaldi (2017); Sturmfels et al. (2020)
key_rationale: Directly addresses the step-edge confound that invalidated naive margin ablation, providing a generalizable artifact-auditing principle for medical XAI. Feasibility is 100% on existing data.

research_question: Does evidence dependence remain invariant across distinct perturbation operators with independent artifact profiles?
key_rationale: Tests consistency across perturbation families, but risks becoming an empirical benchmark comparison without establishing a new theoretical principle.

research_question: Does context reliance differ between intra-axial parenchymal lesions and extra-axial skull-base lesions?
closest_prior_art: Oakden-Rayner et al. (2020); Zech et al. (2018)
key_rationale: Explains why gliomas flip into pituitary under scrambling by linking spatial priors to anatomical compartments. Highly feasible, but primarily an empirical subgroup analysis.

direction_name: Decoupling Spatial Arrangement from High-Frequency Seams
research_question: Can cranial layout dependence be isolated from high-frequency tile-seam edge noise via frequency-matched seamless transformations?
closest_prior_art: Xiao et al. (2021); Fong & Vedaldi (2017); Geirhos et al. (2020)
key_rationale: Directly attacks the largest unresolved flaw of Phase 6 (the tile-seam confound in C5LP), establishing the first method to isolate macro-anatomical topography from micro-edge noise in neuroimaging.

research_question: Does the spatial evidence reliance profile replicate across independent multi-center cohorts (BraTS / TCGA)?
closest_prior_art: Zech et al. (2018); DeGrave et al. (2021); Vangala et al. (2026)
key_rationale: Scientifically vital for external clinical validity, but completely infeasible within current phase constraints (requires external 3D data pipeline, label re-harmonization, multi-center DICOM ingestion).

direction_name: Calibrated Decision Framework for Medical Spatial Audits
research_question: Can a formalized pre-registered protocol with matched placebos and cluster bootstrap eliminate false XAI claims?
closest_prior_art: Maier-Hein & Reinke (2024); Castro et al. (2020); Hooker et al. (2019)
key_rationale: Provides an actionable methodological standard synthesizing placebos, inpainting, and cluster bootstrap, but risks being viewed as an assemblage of existing best practices.
